purpose: Remove only the immediately repeated whole-catalog audit after an assembled publication already completed its full precommit audit. No scoped validator or trust cache is introduced.
changes: The assembled publisher exposes publish_checked_revision, delegating through existing publish_revision so real worker publication-barrier instrumentation and the original commit method remain authoritative.
Receipt staging occurs before the same full Storage._check while the transaction still owns every catalog/source/review/FTS/receipt row. Any final audit error rolls them all back.
Generic Ingest storage still uses publish_revision then check; fresh catalog TXT/physical imports use the explicit checked operation.

Fresh extended-document import uses the checked operation and does not repeat the full check. Terminal replay, _recover, cold LibraryApp open, backup, Storage.check and low-level Storage are unchanged.

performance_evidence.qualification: This is a safe reduction in duplicate work, not a linear-scaling claim. One global per-publication audit and ImportCenter's independent child cold-open audit remain.

peer_review.scope: Full precommit audit/receipt ordering, preserved publication interception, generic/replay paths and actual test API/rollback boundaries.

limitations: Executor unavailable; no AST/pytest/performance/native execution claimed.
Application hunks are exact and intended to compose with unrelated search changes.
